description: 2016 Truck Volume Percentage is a dataset listed in City of Calgary open data portal (data.calgary.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Calgary. Data were compiled from 6 hour intersection counts, 24 hour automatic counts and permanent count stations from 2011 to 2016. Segment truck percentages are based on adjacent intersection counts. In some cases, when no current data was available, older data was used. Coverage: Calgary. The portal files it under the category Transportation/Transit. The table has 5 columns. Attribution on the portal: The City of Calgary. The portal shows 2017-10-13 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-calgary-ca-portal.
